questions.en: Have you EVER claimed to be a U.S. citizen (in writing or any other way)?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha afirmado ser ciudadano estadounidense, por escrito o de cualquier otra forma?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER claimed to be a U.S. citizen (in writing or any other way)?

questions.en: Have you EVER registered to vote or voted in any Federal, state, or local election in the United States?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez se ha inscrito para votar o ha votado en una elección federal, estatal o local en Estados Unidos?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER registered to vote or voted in any Federal, state, or local election in the United States?

formNotes.en: If you lawfully voted only in a local election where aliens are eligible to vote, you may answer “No.”
formNotes.es: Si votó legalmente solo en una elección local en la que los extranjeros tienen derecho a votar, puede responder «No».

questions.en: Do you currently owe any overdue Federal, state, or local taxes in the United States?
questions.es: ¿Actualmente adeuda impuestos federales, estatales o locales vencidos en Estados Unidos?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Do you currently owe any overdue Federal, state, or local taxes in the United States?

questions.en: Since you became a lawful permanent resident, have you called yourself a “nonresident alien” on a Federal, state, or local tax return or decided not to file a tax return because you considered yourself to be a nonresident?
questions.es: Desde que se convirtió en residente permanente legal, ¿se ha declarado «extranjero no residente» en una declaración de impuestos federal, estatal o local, o ha decidido no presentar una declaración porque se consideraba no residente?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Since you became a lawful permanent resident, have you called yourself a “nonresident alien” on a Federal, state, or local tax return or decided not to file a tax return because you considered yourself to be a nonresident?

questions.en: Have you EVER: Been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any Communist or totalitarian party anywhere in the world?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha sido miembro de un partido comunista o totalitario, ha participado en él o ha estado asociado de alguna manera con él en cualquier parte del mundo?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:
questions.officialItemEn: Been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any Communist or totalitarian party anywhere in the world?

questions.en: Have you EVER: Advocated (supported and promoted) any of the following, or been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any group anywhere in the world that advocated any of the following: Opposition to all organized government; World communism; The establishment in the United States of a totalitarian dictatorship; The overthrow by force or violence or other unconstitutional means of the Government of the United States or all forms of law; The unlawful assaulting or killing of any officer or officers of the Government of the United States or of any other organized government because of their official character; The unlawful damage, injury, or destruction of property; or Sabotage?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha defendido (apoyado y promovido) alguna de las siguientes ideas o acciones, o ha sido miembro, ha participado o ha estado asociado de alguna manera con algún grupo, en cualquier parte del mundo, que defendiera alguna de las siguientes: oposición a todo gobierno organizado; comunismo mundial; el establecimiento de una dictadura totalitaria en Estados Unidos; el derrocamiento por la fuerza, la violencia u otros medios inconstitucionales del Gobierno de Estados Unidos o de todas las formas de ley; la agresión o muerte ilegal de cualquier funcionario o funcionarios del Gobierno de Estados Unidos o de cualquier otro gobierno organizado debido a su carácter oficial; el daño, perjuicio o destrucción ilegal de bienes; o el sabotaje?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:
questions.officialItemEn: Advocated (supported and promoted) any of the following, or been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any group anywhere in the world that advocated any of the following: Opposition to all organized government; World communism; The establishment in the United States of a totalitarian dictatorship; The overthrow by force or violence or other unconstitutional means of the Government of the United States or all forms of law; The unlawful assaulting or killing of any officer or officers of the Government of the United States or of any other organized government because of their official character; The unlawful damage, injury, or destruction of property; or Sabotage?

questions.en: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with, or have you EVER provided money, a thing of value, services or labor, or any other assistance or support to a group that: Used a weapon or explosive with intent to harm another person or cause damage to property?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha sido miembro de un grupo, ha participado en él o ha estado asociado de alguna manera con él, o alguna vez ha proporcionado dinero, algo de valor, servicios o trabajo, o cualquier otra ayuda o apoyo a un grupo que utilizó un arma o explosivo con la intención de dañar a otra persona o causar daños a bienes?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with, or have you EVER provided money, a thing of value, services or labor, or any other assistance or support to a group that:
questions.officialItemEn: Used a weapon or explosive with intent to harm another person or cause damage to property?

questions.en: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with, or have you EVER provided money, a thing of value, services or labor, or any other assistance or support to a group that: Engaged (participated) in kidnapping, assassination, or hijacking or sabotage of an airplane, ship, vehicle, or other mode of transportation?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha sido miembro de un grupo, ha participado en él o ha estado asociado de alguna manera con él, o alguna vez ha proporcionado dinero, algo de valor, servicios o trabajo, o cualquier otra ayuda o apoyo a un grupo que participó en secuestros de personas, asesinatos o el apoderamiento ilícito o sabotaje de un avión, barco, vehículo u otro medio de transporte?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with, or have you EVER provided money, a thing of value, services or labor, or any other assistance or support to a group that:
questions.officialItemEn: Engaged (participated) in kidnapping, assassination, or hijacking or sabotage of an airplane, ship, vehicle, or other mode of transportation?

questions.en: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with, or have you EVER provided money, a thing of value, services or labor, or any other assistance or support to a group that: Threatened, attempted (tried), conspired (planned with others), prepared, planned, advocated for, or incited (encouraged) others to commit any of the acts listed in Item Numbers 6.a. or 6.b.?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha sido miembro de un grupo, ha participado en él o ha estado asociado de alguna manera con él, o alguna vez ha proporcionado dinero, algo de valor, servicios o trabajo, o cualquier otra ayuda o apoyo a un grupo que amenazó, intentó (trató), conspiró (planeó con otros), preparó, planeó, promovió o incitó (alentó) a otros a cometer cualquiera de los actos enumerados en los ítems 6.a o 6.b?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with, or have you EVER provided money, a thing of value, services or labor, or any other assistance or support to a group that:
questions.officialItemEn: Threatened, attempted (tried), conspired (planned with others), prepared, planned, advocated for, or incited (encouraged) others to commit any of the acts listed in Item Numbers 6.a. or 6.b.?

questions.en: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: Torture?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha ordenado, incitado, pedido que se realizara, cometido, asistido, ayudado o participado de otra manera en tortura?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following:
questions.officialItemEn: Torture?

questions.en: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: Genocide?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha ordenado, incitado, pedido que se realizara, cometido, asistido, ayudado o participado de otra manera en genocidio?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following:
questions.officialItemEn: Genocide?

questions.en: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: Killing or trying to kill any person?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha ordenado, incitado, pedido que se realizara, cometido, asistido, ayudado o participado de otra manera en matar o intentar matar a alguna persona?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following:
questions.officialItemEn: Killing or trying to kill any person?

questions.en: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: Intentionally and severely injuring or trying to injure any person?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha ordenado, incitado, pedido que se realizara, cometido, asistido, ayudado o participado de otra manera en lesionar grave e intencionalmente o intentar lesionar a alguna persona?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following:
questions.officialItemEn: Intentionally and severely injuring or trying to injure any person?

questions.en: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: Any kind of sexual contact or activity with any person who did not consent (did not agree) or was unable to consent (could not agree), or was being forced or threatened by you or by someone else?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha ordenado, incitado, pedido que se realizara, cometido, asistido, ayudado o participado de otra manera en cualquier tipo de contacto o actividad sexual con alguna persona que no consintió (no estuvo de acuerdo), que no podía consentir (no podía estar de acuerdo), o que estaba siendo forzada o amenazada por usted o por otra persona?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following:
questions.officialItemEn: Any kind of sexual contact or activity with any person who did not consent (did not agree) or was unable to consent (could not agree), or was being forced or threatened by you or by someone else?

questions.en: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: Not letting someone practice his or her religion?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha ordenado, incitado, pedido que se realizara, cometido, asistido, ayudado o participado de otra manera en impedir que alguien practique su religión?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following:
questions.officialItemEn: Not letting someone practice his or her religion?

questions.en: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: Causing harm or suffering to any person because of his or her race, religion, national origin, membership in a particular social group, or political opinion?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha ordenado, incitado, pedido que se realizara, cometido, asistido, ayudado o participado de otra manera en causar daño o sufrimiento a alguna persona por su raza, religión, origen nacional, pertenencia a un grupo social particular u opinión política?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following:
questions.officialItemEn: Causing harm or suffering to any person because of his or her race, religion, national origin, membership in a particular social group, or political opinion?

questions.en: Have you EVER served in, been a member of, assisted (helped), or participated in any military or police unit?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha servido, sido miembro, asistido o participado en una unidad militar o policial?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER served in, been a member of, assisted (helped), or participated in any military or police unit?

questions.en: Have you EVER served in, been a member of, assisted (helped), or participated in any armed group (a group that carries weapons), for example: paramilitary unit (a group of people who act like a military group but are not part of the official military), self-defense unit, vigilante unit, rebel group, or guerrilla group?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha servido en algún grupo armado (un grupo que porta armas), ha sido miembro, ha ayudado o ha participado en él, por ejemplo: una unidad paramilitar (un grupo de personas que actúan como un grupo militar pero no forman parte de las fuerzas militares oficiales), una unidad de autodefensa, un grupo de vigilantes, un grupo rebelde o un grupo guerrillero?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER served in, been a member of, assisted (helped), or participated in any armed group (a group that carries weapons), for example: paramilitary unit (a group of people who act like a military group but are not part of the official military), self-defense unit, vigilante unit, rebel group, or guerrilla group?

questions.en: Have you EVER worked, volunteered, or otherwise served in a place where people were detained (forced to stay), for example, a prison, jail, prison camp (a camp where prisoners of war or political prisoners are kept), detention facility, or labor camp, or have you EVER directed or participated in any other activity that involved detaining people?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha trabajado, ha sido voluntario o ha prestado servicios de otra manera en un lugar donde se detenía a personas (se las obligaba a permanecer), por ejemplo, una prisión, una cárcel, un campo de prisioneros (donde se mantiene a prisioneros de guerra o presos políticos), un centro de detención o un campo de trabajo, o alguna vez ha dirigido o participado en cualquier otra actividad que implicara detener a personas?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER worked, volunteered, or otherwise served in a place where people were detained (forced to stay), for example, a prison, jail, prison camp (a camp where prisoners of war or political prisoners are kept), detention facility, or labor camp, or have you EVER directed or participated in any other activity that involved detaining people?

questions.en: Were you EVER a part of any group, or did you EVER help any group, unit, or organization that used a weapon against any person, or threatened to do so?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez formó parte de algún grupo, o ayudó a algún grupo, unidad u organización que utilizó un arma contra alguna persona o amenazó con hacerlo?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Were you EVER a part of any group, or did you EVER help any group, unit, or organization that used a weapon against any person, or threatened to do so?

questions.en: If you answered “Yes” to Item Number 10.a., when you were part of this group, or when you helped this group, did you ever use a weapon against another person?
questions.es: Si respondió Sí a 10.a, ¿utilizó alguna vez un arma contra otra persona mientras pertenecía o ayudaba a ese grupo?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: If you answered “Yes” to Item Number 10.a., when you were part of this group, or when you helped this group, did you ever use a weapon against another person?

questions.en: If you answered “Yes” to Item Number 10.a., when you were part of this group, or when you helped this group, did you ever threaten another person that you would use a weapon against that person?
questions.es: Si respondió «Sí» al ítem 10.a, cuando formaba parte de este grupo o cuando lo ayudaba, ¿alguna vez amenazó a otra persona con utilizar un arma contra ella?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: If you answered “Yes” to Item Number 10.a., when you were part of this group, or when you helped this group, did you ever threaten another person that you would use a weapon against that person?

questions.en: Have you EVER sold, provided, or transported weapons, or assisted any person in selling, providing, or transporting weapons, which you knew or believed would be used against another person?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha vendido, suministrado o transportado armas, o ayudado a hacerlo, sabiendo o creyendo que se usarían contra alguien?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER sold, provided, or transported weapons, or assisted any person in selling, providing, or transporting weapons, which you knew or believed would be used against another person?

questions.en: Have you EVER received any weapons training, paramilitary training, or other military-type training?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha recibido entrenamiento con armas, paramilitar o de tipo militar?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER received any weapons training, paramilitary training, or other military-type training?

questions.en: Have you EVER recruited (asked), enlisted (signed up), conscripted (required to join), or used any person under 15 years of age to serve in or help an armed group, or attempted or worked with others to do so?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha reclutado (solicitado), alistado (inscrito), obligado a incorporarse o utilizado a alguna persona menor de 15 años para servir o ayudar a un grupo armado, o ha intentado hacerlo o trabajado con otros para hacerlo?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER recruited (asked), enlisted (signed up), conscripted (required to join), or used any person under 15 years of age to serve in or help an armed group, or attempted or worked with others to do so?

questions.en: Have you EVER used any person under 15 years of age to take part in hostilities or attempted or worked with others to do so?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha utilizado a alguna persona menor de 15 años para participar en hostilidades, o ha intentado hacerlo o trabajado con otros para hacerlo?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER used any person under 15 years of age to take part in hostilities or attempted or worked with others to do so?

formNotes.en: This could include participating in combat or providing services related to combat (such as serving as a messenger or transporting supplies).
formNotes.es: Esto podría incluir participar en combate o prestar servicios relacionados con el combate (como servir de mensajero o transportar suministros).

questions.en: Have you EVER committed, agreed to commit, asked someone else to commit, helped commit, or tried to commit a crime or offense for which you were NOT arrested?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha cometido, acordado cometer, pedido a otra persona que cometiera, ayudado a cometer o intentado cometer un delito o infracción por el que NO fue arrestado?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER committed, agreed to commit, asked someone else to commit, helped commit, or tried to commit a crime or offense for which you were NOT arrested?

formNotes.en: The form includes crimes and offenses in the United States or anywhere in the world, including domestic violence, driving under the influence of drugs or alcohol, and crimes and offenses while under age 18. Its instructions cover sealed, expunged, or otherwise cleared records. See the full official page 8 instructions and evidence requirements.
formNotes.es: El formulario incluye delitos e infracciones en Estados Unidos o en cualquier lugar del mundo, incluidos violencia doméstica, conducir bajo los efectos de drogas o alcohol y delitos e infracciones cometidos antes de los 18 años. Sus instrucciones abarcan registros sellados, eliminados o depurados de otra manera. Consulte las instrucciones completas y los requisitos de pruebas de la página 8 oficial.

questions.en: Have you EVER been arrested, cited, detained or confined by any law enforcement officer, military official (in the U.S. or elsewhere), or immigration official for any reason, or been charged with a crime or offense?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha sido arrestado, citado, detenido o confinado por algún agente del orden, funcionario militar (en Estados Unidos o en otro lugar) o funcionario de inmigración por cualquier motivo, o ha sido acusado de un delito o infracción?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER been arrested, cited, detained or confined by any law enforcement officer, military official (in the U.S. or elsewhere), or immigration official for any reason, or been charged with a crime or offense?

formNotes.en: The form includes crimes and offenses in the United States or anywhere in the world, including domestic violence, driving under the influence of drugs or alcohol, and crimes and offenses while under age 18. Its instructions cover sealed, expunged, or otherwise cleared records. See the full official page 8 instructions and evidence requirements.
formNotes.es: El formulario incluye delitos e infracciones en Estados Unidos o en cualquier lugar del mundo, incluidos violencia doméstica, conducir bajo los efectos de drogas o alcohol y delitos e infracciones cometidos antes de los 18 años. Sus instrucciones abarcan registros sellados, eliminados o depurados de otra manera. Consulte las instrucciones completas y los requisitos de pruebas de la página 8 oficial.

questions.en: If you received a suspended sentence, were placed on probation, or were paroled, have you completed your suspended sentence, probation, or parole?
questions.es: Si recibió una sentencia suspendida, fue puesto en libertad a prueba (probation) o recibió libertad condicional (parole), ¿ha completado su sentencia suspendida, libertad a prueba o libertad condicional?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: If you received a suspended sentence, were placed on probation, or were paroled, have you completed your suspended sentence, probation, or parole?

questions.en: Have you EVER: Engaged in prostitution, attempted to procure or import prostitutes or persons for the purpose of prostitution, or received any proceeds or money from prostitution?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha ejercido la prostitución, intentado conseguir o importar prostitutas o personas con fines de prostitución, o recibido ganancias o dinero de la prostitución?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:
questions.officialItemEn: Engaged in prostitution, attempted to procure or import prostitutes or persons for the purpose of prostitution, or received any proceeds or money from prostitution?

questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha fabricado, cultivado, producido, distribuido, dispensado, vendido o introducido de contrabando (traficado) sustancias controladas, drogas ilegales, narcóticos o parafernalia para drogas, infringiendo alguna ley o reglamento de un estado de Estados Unidos, de Estados Unidos o de un país extranjero?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:
questions.officialItemEn: Manufactured, cultivated, produced, distributed, dispensed, sold, or smuggled (trafficked) any controlled substances, illegal drugs, narcotics, or drug paraphernalia in violation of any law or regulation of a U.S. state, the United States, or a foreign country?

questions.en: Have you EVER: Been married to more than one person at the same time?
questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha estado casado con más de una persona al mismo tiempo?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:

questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:

questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:
questions.officialItemEn: Helped anyone to enter, or try to enter, the United States illegally?

questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha participado en apuestas ilegales u obtenido ingresos de ellas?
questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:
questions.officialItemEn: Gambled illegally or received income from illegal gambling?

questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:
questions.officialItemEn: Failed to support your dependents (pay child support) or to pay alimony (court-ordered financial support after divorce or separation)?

questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialStemEn: Have you EVER:
questions.officialItemEn: Made any misrepresentation to obtain any public benefit in the United States?

questions.sourceVerification: Official USCIS PDF indexed text, pages 6–10; direct PDF download returned HTTP 403.
questions.officialItemEn: Have you EVER given any U.S. Government officials any information or documentation that was false, fraudulent, or misleading?

questions.es: ¿Alguna vez ha mentido a algún funcionario del Gobierno de Estados Unidos para obtener entrada o admisión a Estados Unidos o para obtener beneficios migratorios mientras se encontraba en Estados Unidos?

generalFormContext.en: In Part 9, EVER refers to conduct anywhere in the world at any time unless the question specifies otherwise. Read the current official form and instructions for all explanations, evidence and routing requirements. This study module does not collect personal answers.
generalFormContext.es: En la Parte 9, EVER se refiere a conductas en cualquier lugar del mundo y en cualquier momento, salvo que la pregunta indique lo contrario. Lea el formulario oficial vigente y sus instrucciones para conocer todos los requisitos de explicaciones, pruebas y saltos entre preguntas. Este módulo de estudio no recopila respuestas personales.
